steps.en: The processing job runs by itself every 10 minutes
steps.id: Job pemrosesan berjalan sendiri setiap 10 menit

steps.en: New submissions and proof documents are copied into the staff system
steps.id: Submission baru dan dokumen buktinya disalin ke sistem staff

steps.en: Only submissions that pass every check are updated automatically
steps.id: Hanya submission yang lolos semua pengecekan diperbarui otomatis

steps.en: The previous offender is no longer marked as the current offender
steps.id: Offender sebelumnya tidak lagi ditandai sebagai offender saat ini

steps.en: A new hirer or driver record is created with the furnished details
steps.id: Data hirer atau driver baru dibuat dengan detail yang diberikan

steps.en: The furnished mailing address becomes the address used for letters
steps.id: Alamat surat yang diberikan menjadi alamat untuk pengiriman surat

steps.en: The notice moves to its next stage with a new processing date
steps.id: Notice pindah ke stage berikutnya dengan tanggal proses baru

steps.en: The portal copy of the new hirer or driver is saved
steps.id: Salinan hirer atau driver baru di sisi portal disimpan
steps.why_en: Only ID, name and role are copied; email, phone and address are not.
steps.why_id: Hanya ID, nama, dan peran yang disalin; email, telepon, dan alamat tidak.

steps.en: The updated notice is also updated in the payment portal data
steps.id: Notice yang diperbarui juga diperbarui di data portal pembayaran

steps.en: Reminders to the hirer or driver follow the set workflow
steps.id: Reminder ke hirer atau driver mengikuti workflow yang ditetapkan
steps.why_en: Only the next stage is set; reminder letters rely on other jobs and the workflow document is not in the repo.
steps.why_id: Hanya stage berikutnya yang ditetapkan; surat reminder bergantung job lain dan dokumen workflow tidak ada di repo.
